findings.text: When retired receipts answer at all, the predicate returns before consulting the pointer pid or the in-flight attempt marker, so during the window in which a launch has retired the previous receipts, written attempt.json for its own attempt, and not yet written worker.json (a window the startup watch can hold for its whole length), a second concurrent launch for the same placed run reads the older, ended attempt and is admitted, spawning two workers in one worktree; comparing attempt.json's attempt against the newest receipt number would distinguish an in-flight attempt from a replaced one.

The newest-attempt rule that the done_when makes central has no case with two receipt numbers, so a regression that picked the lowest receipt, or any receipt, instead of max would keep all five tests green while an older ended attempt stood in for a newer live one and let a second worker spawn.

The receipt pattern, enumeration and JSON decode duplicate reckon/crew/resumption.py:1005 _attempt_worker_records and :1038 _read_record rather than extending them, so the run directory now has two readers of the same attempt receipts that can drift on how a receipt is named or read.

The real-home guard compares only the top-level entry names of the operator's crew home, so a leaked write into an existing subdirectory such as runs/ or live/ leaves the listing unchanged and the case the done_when requires would pass while the real crew home had been written to.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against base e8fa945150: 486097d6bb adds the receipt helper and reworks the placed-unknown arm plus 299 lines of test, and 9587a26dd7 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for a reproduction plus five named cases through the two guards; tests/test_a_resumed_placed_run_spawns.py:220-331 carries all five, and the manifest's gate logs record 5 passed at the head and 3 of them failing at the base.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that a resumed placed run spawns once its previous attempt has ended; reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2036-2044 implements exactly that predicate for the placed-unknown arm shared by both launch guards.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest states status complete, names commits 486097d6bb and 9587a26dd7, and records each gate's revision, tree, command, result and EXIT code; I reopened every named log and each matches the manifest.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py, tests/test_a_resumed_placed_run_spawns.py, the evidence fragment and the figures directory; the diff's three files are all declared, and the figures directory was declared but left unused.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_resumed_placed_run_spawns.py:211 and :233 redden at the base and under the restored predicate, but no case carries two attempt receipt numbers, so the 'highest N' selection at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1998 could regress to the lowest or any receipt undetected.
justifications.evidence: The manifest records reproduction (repro-defect.log), a base arm at e8fa945150 with the new test copied in (3 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1), a head arm at 486097d6bb (5 passed, EXIT=0), the three-file population at both arms (16 passed / 3 failed 13 passed), and a negative control (3 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1), each log headed by its revision and tree and ended by a bare EXIT= line.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1970 follows the module-private helper and docstring idiom of its neighbours (_record_holds_a_worker at :1949) and ruff check/format add no finding on either staged source file beyond two pre-existing ones at :1152 and :2744.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2036-2044 makes the placed-unknown arm read the newest retired attempt receipts through _retired_attempt_ended, so a resume whose previous attempt has an exit receipt or a dead worker receipt proceeds while a live or unreadable one still refuses.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1967-2009 re-enumerates and re-decodes attempt receipts that reckon/crew/resumption.py:1005 (_attempt_worker_records, with _read_record at :1038) already owns, though no existing owner answers the composed question of whether the newest retired attempt ended.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff e8fa945150..9587a26dd7 touches only reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1966-2044, tests/test_a_resumed_placed_run_spawns.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-worker/a-resumed-placed-run-spawns.html, all inside the node's declared write paths.
